cases.case_label: CTRC-deleting complex rearrangement via L1-mediated Alu insertion
cases.mechanism_detail: A heterozygous complex rearrangement deleting the CTRC locus probably resulted from an LINE-1-mediated Alu insertion; co-inherited with different trans variants in SPINK1/CFTR/PRSS1 with variable phenotypes.
cases.quote: The CTRC-deleting complex rearrangement probably resulted from LINE-1-mediated Alu insertion, which represents a novel mutational mechanism causing chronic pancreatitis.
